name: AssumeRoleCommand
reason: The AWS SDK command token is passed unchanged to send; its input is checked at the constructor.

name: STSClient
reason: The AWS SDK client is only used to send the checked command.

name: ZodNever
reason: Tool schemas in the recorded tool set are carried by reference and never inspected.

name: ReadableStream
reason: The stream is read only through its recorded reader.

name: ReadableStreamDefaultReader
reason: The reader's chunks are recorded per read call.

name: ZodMiniObject
reason: The schema is handed to parseInput, whose own twin validates against it.

name: ZodMiniRecord
reason: The schema is handed to parseInput, whose own twin validates against it.

name: ^new STSClient$
reason: The AWS SDK builds a client; the trace checks the empty configuration.

name: ^new AssumeRoleCommand$
reason: The AWS SDK wraps the request; the trace checks every field of the scoped policy.

name: ^new STSClient\(\{\}\)\.send$
reason: STS answers the checked command; credentials are external input.

name: ^stream\.getReader$
reason: The Web Streams API gives a reader over the caller's stream.

name: ^reader\.read$
reason: The next chunk comes from the caller's stream and is recorded per call.

name: ^reader\.releaseLock$
reason: The Web Streams API frees the reader; the trace checks it runs on every exit.

name: ^executor\.exec$
reason: The sandbox executor is the caller's; the trace checks the exact script and options.

name: ^pending\.resolve$
reason: The promise callback is the caller's; the trace checks the exact reply passed.

name: ^executor\.runBackground$
reason: The sandbox provider starts the job; the trace checks the complete request.

name: ^createSandboxExecutor$
reason: The provider factory returns the executor for the checked configuration.

name: ^workspaceRootFor$
reason: Resolves the sandbox workspace root from the checked configuration.

name: ^Math\.random$
reason: The host supplies randomness; the trace records the value used.

name: ^setTimeout$
reason: The host timer API arms the checked callback and delay.

name: ^setInterval$
reason: The host timer API arms the checked callback and period.

name: ^clearInterval$
reason: The host timer API cancels the checked timer.

name: ^firstSweep\.unref$
reason: The host timer API lets the process exit; no value is used.

name: ^sweeper\.unref$
reason: The host timer API lets the process exit; no value is used.

name: ^crypto\.subtle\.digest$
reason: Web Crypto hashes the checked bytes; the digest is external input.

name: ^new ClientError$
reason: The error class builds the Convex error from the checked message.
